items: Animal exposure precautions (keep distance, no feeding wildlife, follow guide instructions)
Remote medical preparation (know evacuation plan, carry extra first-aid supplies)
Insect protection suited to dense-forest exposure
Mosquito net for accommodation without screened windows
Remote-care planning (nearest clinic, evacuation contact, satellite communication if applicable)
Sun protection (reef-safe sunscreen, rash guard, shade)
Water safety awareness (currents, local warning flags, swimming conditions)
